description: Election Commission - Declare that S. A. S. Ubaidulla as a member of the Medadumbara Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Medadumbara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
